title: Smooth cut-off function for a compact subset of an open set
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let L ⊆ ℝⁿ be compact and O ⊆ ℝⁿ open with L ⊆ O. Then there is χ : ℝⁿ → ℝ of class C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) χ) such that 0 ≤ χ ≤ 1 everywhere, χ = 1 on L, χ has compact support, and tsupport χ ⊆ O.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (L O : Set (Rn n)), IsCompact L → IsOpen O → L ⊆ O → ∃ χ : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) χ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x ∧ χ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ L, χ x = 1) ∧ HasCompactSupport χ ∧ tsupport χ ⊆ O
